name: Tilaknagar Industries Ltd
about: Tilaknagar Industries Ltd. is primarily involved in manufacturing and sale of Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL).  [1]
keyPoints:
Company Overview[1]
Tilaknagar Industries Ltd. (TI) is an Indian alcoholic beverage company with a diverse portfolio of brands across various segments. The company is known for Mansion House Brandy, the largest-selling brandy in India and the second-largest globally.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 26.4% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 26.6%
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -2.77%
Working capital days have increased from 61.9 days to 93.8 days
